html: I am an art enthusiast. During my time in the department, I served as Head of the Publicity Department for a student organization, where I created numerous paintings, cultural and creative products, promotional materials, and posters. In my spare time, I continue to create my own artwork, experimenting with various mediums such as watercolor, gouache, sketching, impasto, vector art, and Chinese ink painting.

html: Apart from my studies, I'm an amateur bartender for my friends! I've turned my dorm room into a cozy little bar where I can relax and create my own cocktails. I've mastered classics like Tequila Sunrise, Passionate Coast, Mojito, Long Island Iced Tea, and Godfather. From time to time, I also enjoy experimenting with new recipes by mixing different syrups, liqueurs, and base spirits!
